tax.text: Boyle sponsors higher taxes on the wealthy to fund government and opposes Republican tax cuts.
tax.quote: This legislation will fight back against Republicans' decades-long scheme to rig our tax code against middle-class families and in favor of multi-millionaires and billionaires.

wages.text: Boyle cosponsored legislation to raise the federal minimum wage, arguing full-time work should lift people out of poverty.
wages.quote: no one who works full time should have to live in poverty

trade.text: Boyle opposed sweeping tariffs, arguing they raise costs for consumers rather than protect American jobs.
trade.quote: Slapping a reckless 25% tariff on Canada and Mexico won't protect American jobs—it will drive up costs and make life more expensive for middle-class families.

debt.text: Boyle pledged to fight any efforts to weaken Social Security and Medicare benefits.
debt.quote: From my first day in Congress, I pledged to fight any efforts to weaken the stability and soundness of earned Social Security & Medicare benefits for millions of Americans

schools.text: Boyle opposes private and religious school voucher programs and supports increased funding for public schools.
schools.quote: Oppose private and religious school voucher programs

immigration.text: Boyle led a letter defending immigrants and opposing a restrictionist change to immigration agency policy.
immigration.quote: America is in fact a nation of immigrants. The agency charged with administering our immigration laws should understand this, and be proud of this heritage.

guns.text: Boyle voted for an assault weapons ban, saying such bans save lives.
guns.quote: Statistics clearly show that an assault weapons ban will save lives.

abortion.text: Boyle condemned the overturning of Roe v. Wade and defended legal abortion access.
abortion.quote: Roe was not the start of abortions, it was the end of women dying from them.

cannabis.text: Boyle supported the MORE Act to decriminalize marijuana at the federal level.
cannabis.quote: it is now time for Congress to take action at the federal level

health.text: Boyle introduced the Choose Medicare Act to let all Americans buy into a public Medicare plan.
health.quote: It's time to give every American the opportunity to choose Medicare, and that's exactly what this bill does.

energy.text: Boyle championed climate legislation and warned that the consequences of climate change are worsening.
energy.quote: With record-shattering temperatures and billions of dollars going toward natural disaster relief, the consequences of climate change are clearer than ever.

voting.text: Boyle reintroduced legislation to remove barriers that keep newly naturalized citizens from casting ballots.
voting.quote: some of our newest American citizens face insurmountable hurdles when it comes to casting a vote in an election

tax.text: On her campaign site she says she will back policies that reduce the tax burden on working families and cut regulations on small businesses.
tax.quote: Jessica will support policies that reduce the tax burden on working families, cut unnecessary federal regulations that hurt small businesses, and expand job training programs tied directly to local employers.

safety.text: She calls for both funding police enforcement against repeat violent offenders and expanding community prevention, mental health and addiction services.
safety.quote: She supports funding for mental health and addiction services alongside policing, because safer neighborhoods require both enforcement and intervention.

health.text: In her Vote411 questionnaire she says she would fully fund and protect Medicaid, cap prescription drug prices and expand preventative care.
health.quote: fully fund and protect medicaid for those who needed most, cap skyrocketing, prescription drug prices, expand preventative care
